info.title: Beyblade X (ITA)
info.synopsis: In questa nuova serie, i professionisti di Beyblade, provenienti da ogni angolo del mondo, si riuniscono per competere nella Pro League, all'interno della celebre X Tower! Il protagonista cercherà in tutti i modi di accedere alla competizione e di sfidare i migliori giocatori.

related.title: Beyblade the Movie: Decisive Battle! Takao VS Daichi

variants.title: Beyblade the Movie: Decisive Battle! Takao VS Daichi

episodes.title: X
episodes.synopsis: Bird Kazami is an amateur blader who came to "X City" to become a professional beyblader.

episodes.title: Multi-Colored Ambush
episodes.synopsis: After revealing his true identity and forming Team Persona with Robin, Jaxon signs the new team up for a pro-selection match.

episodes.title: Team Persona
episodes.synopsis: After their battle with the mega-popular Multi Nana-iro, Jaxon set his sights on a potential third member for Team Persona.

episodes.title: Bey Sponsor
episodes.synopsis: Now that they're officially pros, the hunt is on for Team Persona's Bey Sponsor, who will help them train and climb The X.

episodes.title: To the X
episodes.synopsis: Now that Team Persona is officially sponsored by Komaba Sushi, the team is finally ready to battle at The X.

episodes.title: Lion`s Jungle
episodes.synopsis: Instead of training, Robin, Jaxon and Multi set off to Lions Jungle to scout out their opponents, Team Zooganic, to see if they could gather any intel.

episodes.title: Team Zooganic
episodes.synopsis: It's Team Persona's debut match, they're set to go head-to-head with the inimitable Team Zooganic.

episodes.title: The Mask and the King
episodes.synopsis: The Persona-Zooganic showdown is locked at one point each; it has all come down to Jaxon's battle with Zooganic's leader, Titus Manju.

episodes.title: Beycrafter
episodes.synopsis: After their victory against Team Zooganic, Multi uses some Beycrafting skills to help Robin improve his game.

episodes.title: The Pro Realm
episodes.synopsis: Team Phalanx is hanging on to their sponsorship by a thread, with their upcoming match with Team Persona their last chance to stay in the limelight.

episodes.title: Warden`s Exam
episodes.synopsis: After failing Warden's Exam, Robin wonders if he can ever get to the same level as his teammates.

episodes.title: The Final Battle
episodes.synopsis: Team Persona enters the Solo Battle Fest, a series of exhibition matches in which Bladers showcase their individual personalities and skills.

episodes.title: The First Fan
episodes.synopsis: With all eyes on the mysterious Blader X and the multi-talented Multi Nana-iro, Robin's losing streak starts to weigh on his confidence, until he finds his first fan.

episodes.title: Jax-ercise
episodes.synopsis: Recently, feeling a lack of tension and noticing laxity in Ekusu, Meiden orders specialized training at the Blader Gym. If Ekusu completes the training menu, there's a bonus of Meiden personally becoming the opponent in a Beybattle. Presented with a case containing various Beys, Ekusu's excitement reaches its peak! The prepared menu includes strength training, running, and even swimming, unrelated to battles. Meiden emphasizes that this training is not just for Ekusu but also for Bird...

episodes.title: Riddles and Beys
episodes.synopsis: The invitation to the new sensation theme park "Zonamos House," where you can enjoy both the bey and riddles simultaneously, has been extended to the influencer, Multi. In the most popular 4X attraction, "Riddles and Bey," numerous riddles and battles with unknown creatures await, challenging Bird's Team Persona. They collaborate to overcome various challenges, ultimately reaching a mysterious figure who presents further riddles to Persona!

episodes.title: Noblesse Oblige
episodes.synopsis: In the main attraction of Zonamos House, "Riddles and Beys," the Persona who cleared numerous riddles faces further challenges from Zonamos, the caretaker of Zonamos House. Despite struggling to solve the riddles that started with the cry "Do it!" by Kamen X and Bird, Multi notices something while watching their battle. Although it's said that no one has ever cleared "Riddles and Beys" before, can Persona overcome it?

episodes.title: Bey Timeshift
episodes.synopsis: A mysterious Bey scattered throughout X City. By the time Bird became aware of its existence, it had already fallen into the hands of many bladers. The power of amateur bladers wielding it rivaled that of professionals, and even the shots fired by innocent children in battle were moving at speeds beyond the eye's ability to track with that Bey. Bird, witnessing this phenomenon everywhere, was astonished. The mysterious Bey boasting overwhelming speed enveloped X City...!!

episodes.title: Pride
episodes.synopsis: Due to declining popularity, the professional status of Phalanx is in jeopardy as they prepare for their third showdown. At the behest of sponsors, all members of Phalanx were seen using the mysterious Bey that's been the talk of the city. As they climb X Tower with consecutive victories, they once again stand before Persona! Will Ishiyama and his team, determined to win at all costs to secure a permanent sponsor, come at them?

episodes.title: Zip and Zoom
episodes.synopsis: Persona participates as a guest in the "DATTO" event hosted by Zooganic's King Manju. Bird is mistaken for an amateur participant for some reason and ends up joining on the run side! Throughout various locations, Beybattles unfold, with some amateur bladers even using the mysterious Bey that's the talk of X City. As the finale approaches, even the seasoned pro bladers begin to show signs of fatigue. Amidst both pros and amateurs dropping out, who manages to stay until the very end...!?

episodes.title: Memories of Sushi
episodes.synopsis: Bird discovers a talent outside of Beyblade! His amazing skills for sushi-making end up reminding former top player Ekusu of his past...

episodes.title: Pop Production
episodes.synopsis: "Stop neglecting your appearance so much!" scolded by Multi, Ekusu and Bird were taken to the Blader-exclusive apparel shop "Bladers Dress" to tidy up. While Bird was looking for clothes in the store, a person introducing themselves as the Ambassador told him that he lacked charm as a pro Blader. Furthermore, when told that the shoot for measuring Blader characteristics was "disappointing", Bird, unsatisfied, challenges to a battle...!

episodes.title: Black and White
episodes.synopsis: The next battle has already been set to be against the formidable newly formed Team Yggdrasil! As Nekoyama Zonamos and Namba Yuni step onto the stage, the tension rises up and beyond. That, however, is nothing compared to when their leader...

episodes.title: True Heart
episodes.synopsis: The second battle between Team Ygdrassil and Team Persona commences! As Nanairo Multi and Namba Yuni fight, the latter proposes to bet on their influencer careers...

episodes.title: Arrival of the Fastest
episodes.synopsis: As the final battle with Team Yggdrasil closes in, their leader Fujiwara Burn finally arrives with a beyblade that seems to surpass its predecessor, Phoenix Feather, which has caused chaos within X City..!

episodes.title: Proof of the Fastest
episodes.synopsis: The battle between Persona and Yggdrasil that will determine the team's victory or defeat has finally begun. Kamen X launches his signature Extreme Dash attack, but Burn responds with a confident smile, ready to face it head-on! Despite using his greatest weapon, speed, Kamen X is surpassed by Burn and finds himself in a tight spot. Can Kamen X emerge victorious in the battle against Burn, who has triggered "Bey Time Shift"?! What will be the fate of Persona's team survival?!

episodes.title: Invitation
episodes.synopsis: The "Shuffle Battle Festival" begins, the rules of which demand existing teams to be broken up and for each member to be assigned to a new one! During this event, however, the winners are not chosen by their amount of victories or losses, but their popularity..?!

episodes.title: The End of Persistence
episodes.synopsis: As Byrd passes by the amateur arena, he hears abuse. For some reason, Ishiyama continued to fight against many amateurs without breaking the losing blader's bay. Ishiyama notices Bird and challenges him to a battle, but after many battles, he has clearly exceeded his limits, and he looks thoughtful, as if something is wrong with him... Before long, he has his own bey and starts doing strange things...! Then, an unexpected person appears...! ?

episodes.title: The King and the Phoenix
episodes.synopsis: It's time to let the Shuffle Battle Fest commence! As both active and retired players are brought back to battle within mixed teams, viewers are eager to watch the opening match between unexpected bladers..!

episodes.title: Mask and Meat Buns
episodes.synopsis: The battle between Kamen X and Pan begins. King talks about his encounter with the members of Zooganic, and says that he will realize that his friends are truly strong. How will Kamen Will Persona be able to perform well at the Shuffle Battle Festival and collect votes? ? In the final match of each team, the unexpected Blader finally appears! How will the 4X mascot AI, Ichigo-chan, fight? ?

episodes.title: Riddles and Pop
episodes.synopsis: On the second day of the Shuffle Battle Festival, a battle begins between the team "Multi-sama and I", to which Multi belongs, and the team "Otokogoma". Zonamos, who appeared in the first battle, proposes a mysterious Bey battle that he is good at! Toguro was reluctant to accept Nazotoki, but was pushed along by the excitement at the venue and decided to accept. In the ensuing battle, the man who is closely related to Yuni and Persona clash! ! What will be the outcome of these two battles...?

episodes.title: My Teammates
episodes.synopsis: The battle between teams “Multi-sama and I” and “Otokogoma” has finally reached the final battle! The third battle is a showdown between Multi and Cadover, who also operates the X Tower! Maruti will appear on stage with a flashy performance and liven up the venue wearing idol costumes. Persona is conscious of gaining votes as a team, and Multi works for her friends to stand out, but Cadover starts bringing up stories about Multi when she was working as a one-person team even before the battle…! ?

episodes.title: New Partner
episodes.synopsis: On the final day of the Shuffle Battle Fest, the team Bird belongs to, ``Class Visit'', will be participating. Due to the success of EX and Multi, votes are gathering for Persona, but they still haven't reached the number one spot in the team vote and need more appeal! After receiving advice, Bird switches to a customized launcher and takes on the battle with his new partner. Will Bird, who has prepared to the fullest, be able to perform well in this event and gather votes for Persona?

episodes.title: Our Promise
episodes.synopsis: Meiden will be competing in the final battle for Bird's team, "Class Visit." Meiden was once a professional blader on a team that was expected to reach the top of the X Tower, but due to certain circumstances, he retired from active duty. The audience, who knew of his past achievements, are excited by Meiden's appearance. Before the battle, Meiden says something cryptic while holding his Bey. What is his intention in participating in this Shuffle Battle Fest...?! And so the event ends, and the curtains rise on another battle.

episodes.title: A Rainbow Guest
episodes.synopsis: While Ex and Bird are helping out at Komaba Sushi, Nanairo Shiguru, a member of the X Tower champion team, suddenly visits the store. Shiguru doesn't acknowledge the abilities of the other members except Persona Ex, and asks Ex if he's not going back to Pendragon, but Ex suggests that Shiguru battle Bird. Then Multi appears, and an unexpected relationship between them is revealed...! Can Persona prove the strength of their team to Shiguru?

episodes.title: The Dream Contest
episodes.synopsis: The All-Star Battle begins, a battle between those chosen by vote in the Shuffle Battle Fest! Persona's opponent is the impromptu team "Dreams," formed from the top three individual votes. One of the team members, Blader Manjuu Quinn, said to be a living legend, changes the battle format to a knockout tournament! The first blader, Bird, faces off against the super popular Beytuber Pakkun. What he pulls out is the same Bey as Bird...?!

episodes.title: Bladership
episodes.synopsis: Multi is Persona's second blader who will face Pakkun, who won the first match of the All-Star Battle. Although he is a genius Beycrafter, Multi is quietly angry at Pakkun for using a Bird's Bey that was copied in a way that is unbecoming of a professional blader in the first match...! As confusion and criticism grow in the audience as they get closer to the truth about the Bey copy, Queen of the Beasts declares that the match will continue...!

episodes.title: Unpredictable
episodes.synopsis: Dreams' second Blader is Jyura Rex, known as the Undefeated Killer. He is known for his ferocity, and is overwhelmingly popular with fans looking for thrilling battles. The crowd erupts in cheers as Rex appears! From start to finish, Rex keeps jumping around and rampaging, repeating unpredictable onslaughts, forcing the Personas into a difficult battle. Bird and Multi are worried about Masked X in this battle where they don't know what's going to happen, but Masked X, who approaches the battle as usual, uses an unexpected strategy!?

episodes.title: Return of the Queen
episodes.synopsis: The crowd erupts in cheers as the final battle decides whether Queen of the Beasts, who holds a record of 9,999 wins and 9 losses, will achieve her 10,000th victory, or whether Kamen X will break his undefeated record!

episodes.title: The Greatest Blader
episodes.synopsis: The match was decided in a fierce clash between the Ten Thousand Beasts Queen, who was able to parry and nullify the opponent's attacks, and Masked X, who unleashed an unknown extreme dash.

episodes.title: The Other Mask
episodes.synopsis: Suddenly, Bird is challenged to a battle by a mysterious Masked Y. Masked Y continues to appear throughout X City, challenging the professional bladers that Masked X has fought to battles.

episodes.title: The Three Masks
episodes.synopsis: Following Masked Y, Masked Z appears, hunting down professional Bladers.

episodes.title: XYZ
episodes.synopsis: Z challenges X to a battle, but suddenly stops the battle and leaves.

episodes.title: Pendragon, Back Then
episodes.synopsis: Since his professional debut, Pendragon has been winning consecutive games, steadily climbing to the top.

episodes.title: Family, Back Then
episodes.synopsis: As Bird worries about which Bey to use in the final battle, Multi begins to tell him about his past. No matter how hard he tries, he can't beat Shiguru with his Beyblade...

episodes.title: You, Back Then
episodes.synopsis: A blader with dreams takes his first steps into X City. Although he performs as well as an amateur, the wall to become a professional is high and steep.

episodes.title: Time Off
episodes.synopsis: Just before the summit showdown, Bird is given a day off to rest and get away from his Beys, so he and X return to their hometown.

episodes.title: Battle at the Top
episodes.synopsis: Finally, the summit decisive battle approaching tomorrow. With the thoughts for the actual performance, each spends the night the night... On the day of the greeting, Persona was surrounded by the press.

episodes.title: The Nana-iro Showdown
episodes.synopsis: In the first battle of the Summit Showdown, Shiguru and Multi face off.

episodes.title: Something Xtraordinary
episodes.synopsis: While Z and Bird were in high spirits, it was Ryugu Chrome who stepped up as the second blader. In response, X stepped forward as well.

episodes.title: The Two Xs
episodes.synopsis: The head-on collision between the two Extreme Dashes was so powerful that it caused a crack in the Doranbuster.

episodes.title: The Most Fun Ever
episodes.synopsis: The final battle of the summit showdown has finally come.

episodes.title: Restart
episodes.synopsis: After the Summit Battle, Persona vows to reach the top once again!

episodes.title: Signs of a New Era
episodes.synopsis: Zooganic and Yggdrasil are strong candidates to challenge for the title match. However, Burn, who has refused to play against any other team, seems to have a plan...?

episodes.title: Path of Resolve
episodes.synopsis: Senior Director Gigatani won't allow Pendragon to compete in the official match without Chrome.

episodes.title: Advance Bey Timeshift
episodes.synopsis: In response to Burn's request to try out the Phoenix Ladder, Ishiyama visits Yggdrasil Pharmaceuticals.

episodes.title: Star Plot
episodes.synopsis: Shiroboshi Tenka suddenly appears at Komaba Sushi. He comes with the intention of having a bey battle with Masked X, but Masked X himself is not there.

episodes.title: Tri-Blader Battle
episodes.synopsis: Finally, Persona's next match has been decided! When they head to X Tower without knowing the details, three teams have been called: Persona, Yggdrasil, and Zooganic.

episodes.title: Triple Battle
episodes.synopsis: Multi, Pan, and Zonamos were chosen as the second bladers for the triple battle.

episodes.title: Blader S
episodes.synopsis: The third bladers are Mask S, King and Burn! A heated battle ensues, and who will initiate the fight...?! And from B4, the new stadium will be unveiled for the first time in the world!

episodes.title: Multi-Colored Trial
episodes.synopsis: Convinced that we are entering a new era, Burn, Zonamos, and Yuni come to Yggdrasil Pharmaceuticals' research lab on an isolated island. The sudden visitor seems to know the details of Mask S...?

episodes.title: Invincible
episodes.synopsis: Mask X readily accepts Tenka's condition that he will listen to his orders if he wins the battle, and they battle in the Double Extreme Stadium that he had prepared!

episodes.title: The Prestigious Bey Academy
episodes.synopsis: A special lesson taught by my teacher, Mr. Megaoka. Although confused, Maruti gradually remembers the basics of Baycraft...

episodes.title: The Manju Clan
episodes.synopsis: To train in baycraft, Multi visits Animal Castle, home to the Ten Thousand Beasts. Multi is overwhelmed by the warm hospitality shown to her by King and Quinn's family.

episodes.title: The Shapeless Shadow
episodes.synopsis: Multi, who is working hard on his Beycraft, takes a break and has a Bey battle with Joca. What advice did Joca give Multi?

episodes.title: First Flight
episodes.synopsis: Bird tells Tenka how he got started with Beyblade. His reaction when he first got the chance to play with a Beyblade was in stark contrast to how he is now...!?

episodes.title: Something Captivating
episodes.synopsis: Tsubasa is afraid of winning, but Bird yells at him to give it his all! The reason why Bird aims to become a professional blader is now revealed!

episodes.title: Silver Wolf
episodes.synopsis: Masked X and Bird visit Pakkun for some intensive training. The next day, a disturbing video is posted... Meanwhile, Masked X wants to introduce his master to Bird and Tenka. Who is that master...?!

episodes.title: Light and Dark
episodes.synopsis: Ginrou invites Ex to join him in a fight to protect the world from the underground gang. Ex's future will depend on a triple battle with Tenka! What will the outcome be?

episodes.title: Shadowy Underground
episodes.synopsis: Ginrou and his group arrive at an abandoned warehouse and begin battling the underground pros, with the condition that if they win, they will be able to take Pakkun home!

episodes.title: Dread Dragon
episodes.synopsis: It's the day of the exhibition match! Just as Ciel is beginning to walk his own path to becoming the strongest, Blade appears suddenly in front of him...

episodes.title: To That Place
episodes.synopsis: Omega hands Chrome a Bey with forbidden power! He witnesses the power of the Demon Dragon with his own eyes... What path will Chrome choose...?

episodes.title: Labyrinth of Riddles and Terror
episodes.synopsis: The promotional event for the new stadium has begun! Bird goes to check out the identity of the ghost he saw on the security camera, but what awaits him...?

episodes.title: The Star Battle
episodes.synopsis: At Tenka's request, Persona decides to join the duel for a win, but he notices a familiar face among his opponents! Persona's first match begins!

episodes.title: Cursed
episodes.synopsis: Persona vs. Gordius, a showdown between leaders and Karla! Bird is reminded of the curse that was placed on Rayu some time ago...!

episodes.title: Return of the Knight
episodes.synopsis: When Rayu tries to put a curse on him that he cannot win, Multi shows off his new bey and smiles fearlessly. How will the battle between the knight and the ghost end?

episodes.title: White Nova
episodes.synopsis: What strategy will Tenka use against Iwao, who boasts a high winning rate?! As the battle nears its end, with both of their stamina depleted, the situation changes dramatically!

episodes.title: Blue Dragon and Dread Dragon
episodes.synopsis: Ekusu reunites with Khrome at the street battle arena. Ekusu is excited to fight Khrome again, but...

episodes.title: Customization
episodes.synopsis: Toguro and Pan visit Animal Castle to try customizing their bays. What is Quinn's true purpose in sending them out?

episodes.title: King and Queen
episodes.synopsis: In order to attract attention, Pakkun plans to have Dreams enter a duel for a win. He skillfully convinces Quinn and Rex to reunite, but who will be their first opponent?

episodes.title: The Gradual One
episodes.synopsis: Ishiyama was invited as a guest to a special program. Byrne said he wanted to master the slowest, the opposite of the fastest, but on the way home he couldn't understand what he meant...

episodes.title: All In
episodes.synopsis: The new Persona bay will be unveiled against Phalanx. This highly anticipated battle will test the true worth of the new bay!

episodes.title: Multi-Colored Decision
episodes.synopsis: After Pendragon was defeated in the Ultimate Summit Battle, Multi appears with a new Bey and challenges Shiguru to a duel for victory. What will be the outcome of the 10,002nd showdown with his sister?

episodes.title: Partner
episodes.synopsis: Bird is anxious because he can't draw out the power of the new Bey Hell's Reaper. Unable to bear it any longer, Meiden takes Bird to the beach. What is his goal?

episodes.title: Proxy Conflict
episodes.synopsis: The Personas use beys created by Multi, while the Zooganics use beys created by the Manjuu Clan, and the duel is fought under special rules, with the Beycrafter proxy war, so to speak, beginning!

episodes.title: Pop vs Curse
episodes.synopsis: A duel between Gordius and Yggdrasil! With a minimum of 20 wins bet on each set, the battle becomes tense!

episodes.title: Red Confrontation
episodes.synopsis: The fiery firebird showdown between Karla and Vern has finally begun! Who will burn their opponent to ashes and soar to greater heights on wings of fire?!

episodes.title: Path of the Dread Dragon
episodes.synopsis: Chrome is wandering alone in search of a stronger opponent when Blade appears and challenges him to a battle. He then uses Ex's name to provoke Chrome...

episodes.title: Blading Soul
episodes.synopsis: After learning from Ciel about Ginrou, a master he shares with Ex, Sigurd visits him to ask for his lessons. He takes on the training one by one, but it's not that easy...

episodes.title: What Must Be Done
episodes.synopsis: Ciel is shocked to learn that Chrome has gone underground as Masked Y, but then he receives an invitation to joint training from an unexpected person...!?

episodes.title: Nine-Tailed Fox
episodes.synopsis: Yoko Kyubi, the leader of Miss Leaders, came to visit Pakkun after seeing his live stream. Yoko said she was a big fan, and Pakkun got carried away...

episodes.title: Dream Match
episodes.synopsis: The first set of the Miss Leaders vs. Dreams match is a showdown between Fusaka Dokuga and Pakkun. Next up is a man who has extraordinary feelings for Quinn...

episodes.title: Perseus the Messenger
episodes.synopsis: Roji Lantz suddenly appears, challenging Bird to a battle with high risk and high reward. It may seem like a reckless challenge, but Bird accepts!

episodes.title: Super Champion Challenger Chooser Match
episodes.synopsis: Bird, still feeling the frustration of his battle with Lantz, devotes himself to training. Meanwhile, the final battle to determine the ultimate challenger has been announced!

episodes.title: Unknown
episodes.synopsis: The first set of the Ultimate Challenger Tournament is a showdown between Masked X and Isshin Ryu! Masked X's insensitive remarks only fuel Ryu's fighting spirit...!

episodes.title: Foxes Enchant, Tanukis Bewitch
episodes.synopsis: Multi challenges the superiorly skilled Kyuubi Yoko. In this battle, they deceive and trick each other! Will Multi's clever strategy be the winning move?

episodes.title: Shiroboshi, Back Then
episodes.synopsis: At the Hakusei-ryu dojo of the past, young Tenka trains hard with his senior disciples. ...And then his mother, Omega, disappears. What is the truth behind the parting that lies behind the battle between mother and son?

episodes.title: Star Battle Grand Final
episodes.synopsis: The day of the final battle has finally arrived. However, Masked X's Doran Brave is suspected of tampering, and Masked X himself is suspended from the competition!

episodes.title: Never Defeated
episodes.synopsis: The second set of the final showdown is a showdown between Bird and Lantz! Can they overcome the overwhelming difference in skill?

episodes.title: Supernova
episodes.synopsis: A supreme mother-daughter showdown between a former and current assistant instructor of the Hakusei-ryu. Who will be the one to claim the undefeated Hakusei-ryu?

episodes.title: Star Devourer
episodes.synopsis: The final set is about to begin. Sparks fly as unprecedented clashes and power surpasses limits!

related.title: Bakuten Shoot Beyblade (ITA)
related.plot: Beyblade (Bakuten Shoot Beyblade) segue le vicende di Takao Kinomiya, un ragazzo che come tanti ama giocare a beyblade, sebbene non sia una cima. Takao un giorno entra in possesso di un Bit Power: Dragoon e grazie a quest'ultimo finirà per diventare campione nazionale del Giappone. In vista del torneo mondiale di beyblade il presidente Daitenji decide di formare la squadra dei BladeBreAkers (BBA) composta dai primi quattro classificati al torneo nazionale. E così Takao Kinomiya, Kai Hiwatari (pronunciato Kei nella versione italiana), Rei Kon e Max Mizuhara girano per il mondo sfidando avversari sempre più forti per vincere l'ambito titolo di campioni del mondo. Tuttavia un'organizzazione malvagia cercherà di approfittare del torneo per lanciarsi alla conquista del mondo sfruttando l'immenso potere generato dai Bit Power.

related.plot: Beyblade G-Revolution (Bakuten Shoot Beyblade G Revolution) segue le vicende di Takao Kinomiya, un ragazzo che come tanti ama giocare a beyblade, sebbene non sia una cima. Takao un giorno entra in possesso di un Bit Power: Dragoon e grazie a quest'ultimo finirà per diventare campione nazionale del Giappone. In vista del torneo mondiale di beyblade il presidente Daitenji decide di formare la squadra dei BladeBreAkers (BBA) composta dai primi quattro classificati al torneo nazionale. E così Takao Kinomiya, Kai Hiwatari (pronunciato Kei nella versione italiana), Rei Kon e Max Mizuhara girano per il mondo sfidando avversari sempre più forti per vincere l'ambito titolo di campioni del mondo. Tuttavia un'organizzazione malvagia cercherà di approfittare del torneo per lanciarsi alla conquista del mondo sfruttando l'immenso potere generato dai Bit Power.

related.title: Metal Fight Beyblade (ITA)
related.plot: Ginga Hagane (Gingka nell'edizione italiana) assieme a Pegasus, il suo beyblade, decide di viaggiare intorno al mondo per vendicare suo padre e riprendere L-Drago: il bey proibito rubato da Doji e Ryuga. Durante il suo viaggio finisce per fermarsi in una città in cui si farà degli amici (Kenta, Madoka, ecc.) e dei rivali. Finalmente Gingka scopre dove si trova Doji e dopo aver superato le trappole tese da quest'ultimo sfida Ryuga, ma viene sconfitto. Tuttavia Gingka non si arrende e avrà la sua rivincita nel torneo Battle Blader dopo la sconfitta mortale di Doji.

related.title: Metal Fight Beyblade: Baku (ITA)
related.plot: Questa serie non è altro che un clone di Beyblade. Dopo aver selezionato i 4 rappresentanti del Giappone: Gingka, Masamune, Tsubasa e Yu che costituiscono il team dei Galaxy Gan Gan, la squadra gira per il mondo affrontando i blader più forti per ottenere il titolo mondiale nel torneo Big Bang Blader. L'unica variante è il ripescaggio dei team che hanno perso contro i protagonisti al solo scopo di vedere dei match extra. Il dottor Ziggurat vuole approfittare del torneo per realizzare i suoi piani, ma fallisce e viene sconfitto da un blader tradito.

related.title: Metal Fight Beyblade 4D (ITA)
related.plot: Questa serie ruota attorno ai blader leggendari, 10 individui che possiedono un frammento di stella all'interno dei loro Bey. Secondo la profezia di Re Hades, il signore della Distruzione Nemesis risorgerà portando il caos nel mondo avvolgendo il pianeta nel Sole Nero. Solo i blader leggendari possono fermarlo e Gingka scopre di far parte di questa élite. Con l'aiuto dei suoi amici Gingka parte alla ricerca degli altri 9 blader leggendari per imprigionare Nemesis nella Barriera di Zeus.

related.title: BeyWheelz (ITA)
related.plot: Sho Tenma, del team Estrella, diventa campione del mondo di BeyWheelz e dovrà difendere il suo titolo dal team Dominators, e da chiunque desideri sfidarlo.

related.title: Metal Fight Beyblade Zero G (ITA)
related.plot:
La serie si svolge sette anni dopo gli eventi di Beyblade Metal Fury e ha come protagonista Zyro Kurogane, un Blader che, forte della sua passione per il Beyblade e del suo Bey Samurai Ifrit, donatogli da Gingka Hagane in persona, parte per un viaggio che lo porterà a conoscere nuovi Blader. Dovrà però fare i conti con l'organizzazione DNA, che vuole assumere il controllo di tutto il mondo del Beyblade, ma lo stesso Zyro, con l'aiuto degli amici di Gingka, riesce a distruggere la crudele DNA e sconfiggere anche Doji, dopo aver liberato Gingka il campione, protagonista di Beyblade Metal Fusion, Beyblade Metal Masters e Beyblade Metal Fury.

In questa serie gli scontri si svolgono in stadi, particolari, detti “Stadi del ciclone”, caratterizzati dal campo di gioco che si muove a seconda dei movimenti dei Beyblade; inoltre, in questi stadi l'unica possibilità di far uscire il Bey avversario dal campo di gioco, dal momento che è circondato da delle barriere, è quella di spingerlo attraverso una fessura vicino al bordo del campo di gioco. L'altra opzione per vincere è aspettare che il Beyblade dell'avversario si fermi.
La storia ruoterà  attorno allo scontro fra due giovani duellanti, Balt, proprietario di Valkirie e Shuu, che possiede il potente Sprigan!

In questa nuova serie, i professionisti di Beyblade, provenienti da ogni angolo del mondo, si riuniscono per competere nella Pro League, all'interno della celebre X Tower! Il protagonista cercherà in tutti i modi di accedere alla competizione e di sfidare i migliori giocatori.
